verses.text: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Psalm of David. Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness! You have relieved my distress; show me grace and hear my prayer.

segments.text: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Psalm of David. Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness! You have relieved my distress; show me grace and hear my prayer.

verses.text: How long, O men, will my honor be maligned? How long will you love vanity and seek after lies? Selah

segments.text: How long, O men, will my honor be maligned? How long will you love vanity and seek after lies? Selah

verses.text: Know that the LORD has set apart the godly for Himself; the LORD hears when I call to Him.

segments.text: Know that the LORD has set apart the godly for Himself; the LORD hears when I call to Him.

verses.text: Be angry, yet do not sin; on your bed, search your heart and be still. Selah

segments.text: Be angry, yet do not sin; on your bed, search your heart and be still. Selah

verses.text: Offer the sacrifices of the righteous and trust in the LORD.

segments.text: Offer the sacrifices of the righteous and trust in the LORD.

verses.text: Many ask, “Who can show us the good?” Shine the light of Your face upon us, O LORD.

segments.text: Many ask, “Who can show us the good?” Shine the light of Your face upon us, O LORD.

verses.text: You have filled my heart with more joy than when grain and new wine abound.

segments.text: You have filled my heart with more joy than when grain and new wine abound.

verses.text: I will lie down and sleep in peace, for You alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.
